fields.description: Program Description 1. Program Overview Editor Notes: As a graduate engineer, you will be able to deal with anything from power engineering to microelectronics, radar installations to the design of digital systems. Electrical and Electronic engineering graduates are qualified for professional practice or graduate work in several areas of specialization. In addition to the fundamentals of science and mathematics, the program provides a solid background in circuits, analog, and digital electronics, microprocessors, and electromagnetics. The senior-level classes offered for electrical/electronic engineers include control systems, communication systems, digital signal processing, electro-optics, and digital system design. The program is accredited by the Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology. 2. Main Courses Editor Notes: The core courses which will be instructed in the 4 years are listed below. Spread Spectrum Communication Engineering Electromagnetic Field Matlab Applications Engineering Electromagnetic Field Microwave Technique and Antenna Signals and Systems Random Signal Analysis Digital Signal Processing Areospace Power Supply System Positioning and Navigation System 3. Future Career Fields After Graduation? Editor Notes: The fields listed below are most graduates choose to do after graduation. Broadcast engineer Control and instrumentation engineer Design engineer Electrical engineer Electronics engineer IT consultant Network engineer Nuclear engineer Systems analyst Military Service and other related technology-intensive fields 4. Accreditation: Accredited By The Ministry Of Education, China. NUAA's Degree Is Accepted Worldwide Editor Notes: Students can find their desirable job in the over 2000 on-campus recruitment fairs. NUAA's International Link: NUAA's degree allows you to take your project in China, your home country or a third country. NUAA has partnered with top universities in the USA, Australia, and the EU where some students take their third or fourth year of study. Career Prospects: NUAA has developed strong cooperation with several domestic and international enterprises. Collaboration between academia and industry is increasingly a critical component of efficient national and even global innovation systems. Every year over 2000 companies come to NUAA for on-campus recruitment fairs. 5. Introduction of Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics Editor Notes: World's top 150 Engineering Universities (U.S News Ranking 2018). Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics(NUAA) , established in 1952, enjoys a well-balanced development of multiple disciplines in natural sciences, humanities, social sciences, management, etc. with the characteristics of aeronautics, astronautics and civil aviation. NUAA is among the first batch of national key universities entitled to award doctoral degree, master's degree and bachelor's degree. It is one of the 52 universities with graduate school in China, and it has also been listed in the "National Project 211" as one of the 100 key universities for the 21st century. Presently, NUAA has established international cooperation and exchange with more than 60 universities and institutions all over the world. Learn More>> 6. Colourful Life Editor Notes: More colourful activities are waiting for you to explore. International Cultural Festival Mini-Graduation Ceremony

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. * 2. Non-Criminal letter * 3. Two letters of recommendation from high school teachers, with signature and contact * 4. Financial Guarantee Letter or bank statement * 5. English language proficiency certificate Certificate Letter that English is the learning language during study duration, or English scores in senior high school, or copy of the official IELTS certificate TOFEL certificate. * 6. Photocopy of Foreigner Physical Examination Form You can download a template or sample from here . * 7. Original or notarized copy of transcripts for all the courses in senior high school. Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 8. Personal statement (no more than 800 words), including personal introduction, reasons for application and individual advantages * 9. Resume Written in Chinese or in English * 10. Original or notarized copy of senior high school diploma Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. Applicants who will graduate can provide pre-graduation certificate instead. The original or notarized diploma shall be submitted upon registration. * 11. Scanned copy of passport front page(and valid China visa page if you are already in China) * 12. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -CSCA test is mandatory for every application. The test score should be supplemented Before May 30, 2026. Engineering programs: Mathematics and Physics, both in English. Business program: Mathematics, in English. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.

Business program: Mathematics, in English.
